senses.gloss:
श्लक्ष्ण श्लक्ष्ण अस्, आ, अम् (according to
Uṇādi-s. III. 19. fr. rt. श्लिष्), small, fine, thin,
minute, slender, delicate; smooth, even, plain,
polished; beautiful, pleasing, charming, soft, gentle,
mild, amiable; honest, sincere, candid.
—श्लक्ष्ण-
त्वच्, क्, m. smooth bark; (क्), m. ‘having a smooth
bark,’ a kind of plant (= अश्मन्तक).

श्लक्ष्णक, अस्, आ, अम्, smooth, even; beautiful,
pleasing; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Areca Catechu,
the Areca nut.

श्लक्ष्णय, Nom. P. श्लक्ष्णयति, -यितुम्, to
make thin or small.

श्लङ्क् श्लङ्क् (= rt. श्रङ्क्, q. v.), cl. 1. A.
श्लङ्कते, शश्लङ्के, श्लङ्कितुम्, to go,
move.

श्लङ्ग् श्लङ्ग् (= rt. श्रङ्ग्), cl. 1. P. श्लङ्-
गति, &c., to go, move.

श्लथ् श्लथ् (apparently a later form of
rt. श्रथ्, q. v.), cl. 1. 10. P. श्लथति,
&c., श्लथयति, -यितुम्, to be loose or relaxed or
flaccid, be unfastened; to be weak; to hurt, kill.

श्लथ, अस्, आ, अम्, relaxed, loose, flaccid; untied,
unfastened; dishevelled (as hair).
—श्लथ-बन्-
धन, अस्, ई, अम्, having the muscles relaxed.
—श्लथ-लम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging loosely.
—श्ल-
थोद्यम (˚थ-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, relaxing one's
efforts.
श्लथत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being loose or relaxed.

श्लवण श्लवण, अस्, m. = श्रवण; [cf.
श्लोण.]

श्लाख् श्लाख् (= rt. शाख्), cl. 1. P. श्ला-
खति, श्लाखितुम्, to pervade, pene-
trate, embrace.

श्लाघ् श्लाघ्, cl. 1. A. श्लाघते (ep. also
P. -ति), शश्लाघे, अश्लाघिष्ट, श्लाघि-
तुम्, to flatter, coax, wheedle (with dat.); to praise,
commend, applaud, celebrate, eulogise; to be proud
of, boast of (with inst.): Pass. श्लाघ्यते, Aor.
अश्लाघि, to be praised or celebrated or magnified:
Caus. श्लाघयति, -ते, -यितुम्, Aor. अशश्लाघत्, to
approve, praise, celebrate, congratulate; [cf. Gr. κρή-
γυον, probably κόλαξ: Hib. sleigh, ‘adoration;’
sleachd, ‘adoration;’ sleachdaim, ‘I adore.’]
श्लाघन, अम्, n. the act of flattering, praising, &c.

श्लाघनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-
worthy, laudable, commendable.

श्लाघमान, अस्, आ, अम्, flattering, praising; con-
gratulating one's self, rejoicing.
श्लाघयित्वा, ind. having praised or applauded.

श्लाघा, f. flattery, praise, commendation, pane-
gyric, eulogium; boasting; service, obedience; wish,
desire.
—श्लाघा-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, meriting praise.
श्लाघित, अस्, आ, अम्, flattered, praised, commended.
श्लाघित्वा, ind. having flattered, having praised, &c.

श्लाघिन्, ई, इनी, इ, flattering, praising, commend-
ing; desiring.

श्लाघ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or commended,
praiseworthy, entitled to praise or veneration, venera-
ble, respectable, honourable.
श्लाघ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being praised, &c.
